name: DashThis
description:
DashThis is a marketing reporting platform. It pulls data from 30+ marketing integrations — Google Analytics 4, Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, Search Console, Shopify and more — into dashboards that agencies and in-house marketing teams use to report results to clients and stakeholders.

This connector lets Claude read the dashboards on your DashThis account, so the reporting you have already built becomes something you can talk to. It cannot change anything in your account.

What you can do:
• "What dashboards do I have?" — list and search dashboards across all your clients
• "Pull last month's numbers for the Acme dashboard" — read a dashboard's current widget values
  for any preset reporting period
• "How does that compare to the previous period?" — period-over-period or year-over-year
• "Draft a recap email for this client" — turn the numbers into a client-ready update
• "Which dashboards have a broken data source?" — spot connection errors across the account

Four tools. Three read your reporting: whoami, list_dashboards and get_dashboard_data. The fourth, provide_feedback, is internal — when Claude can't do something you asked for, it reports the gap to DashThis so we know what to improve, and points you to our help center. It records a note at DashThis and writes nothing to your account.

What it cannot do for now: create, edit, delete, send or schedule anything in your DashThis account. It reads only the data already present on your dashboards' widgets — it does not reach back into the source platforms for anything not already on a widget.

Requires a DashThis account. You connect with OAuth by signing in to DashThis — Claude never sees your DashThis password, and never touches the API keys behind your connected marketing integrations.

_published_faq.name: How do I add DashThis to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add DashThis to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.dashthis.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the DashThis MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: DashThis provides these MCP tools: get_dashboard_data, list_dashboards, provide_feedback, and whoami.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to DashThis?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to DashThis in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
DashThis requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
DashThis is developed by DashThis. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
